conditions.name: p1-ids
conditions.description: Run 1 presentation (examples carry meaning IDs only), new seeds. Replicates the baseline and shows whether run 1 was typical.

conditions.name: p1-inline
conditions.description: Examples carry their meaning fields. Removes the ID-join confound.

conditions.name: p1-inline-shuffled
conditions.description: Inline examples, targets shuffled per call, opaque IDs. Removes enumeration-order structure entirely. Default clean baseline for later phases.

conditions.name: p2-framing
conditions.description: Clean baseline plus a statement that a partner must decode the forms. Told, but no feedback.

conditions.name: p2-game
conditions.description: Clean baseline plus a speaker/listener game with revision from the listener's mistakes.

conditions.name: p3-action-first
conditions.description: Field order action, agent, patient, tense. Tests position as the cause of which dimension drops.

conditions.name: p3-action-last
conditions.description: Field order agent, patient, tense, action.

conditions.name: p3-nonsense-actions
conditions.description: Action words replaced by meaningless tokens. Tests semantic salience as the cause of which dimension drops.

conditions.name: p3-sonnet-none
conditions.description: Clean baseline with a larger model.

conditions.name: p3-sonnet-game
conditions.description: Game condition with a larger model.
